headline: Weak '123456' password tied to breach of Denmark's national registry
summary: A hacker breached Denmark's Central Register of Persons, accessing 8.8 million records, through a weakly secured account at a small IT and data services business. The hacker claimed one of the compromised accounts was protected only by the password '123456'; local media reported three weakly protected accounts at the firm were abused.
